about: meter: a meter other than 4/4 for the unit (1/4 to 16/4, 1/8 to 16/8), chosen on a page of its own (shift and help, in any mode) and kept with the tape under the key meter. The metronome accents the first beat of each bar; an x/8 meter clicks on eighth notes (or on quarter notes, the owner's choice). The tape follows the meter: its bar lines, its grid lines, its snap unit (and with it the keys that jump along the tape) and the bar that winding by hand stops at. Version 4: the count-in is one bar of the meter's clicks. Eight places of OS 1.7.3+0: a jump with a trampoline at the metronome's beat function; four calls of on-chip routines, each with a room, where the pack hands the firmware its own count or dividend; a jump with a trampoline at the count-in's step function; the load of the count-in record's address in the metronome's tick; and a jump with a trampoline at the load of the number the count-in's popup prints (profile.json). At 4/4 each runs as it came. OS 1.7.3+0 under open-field 0.12 or later only.
